pick.headline: Pakistan's President Zia killed in plane crash
pick.fbis: The Near East & South Asia Daily Report of August 17, 1988, carried Pakistani radio's report that Zia had died in a crash with senior generals and US Ambassador Raphel, Ghulam Ishaq Khan assuming the presidency, and an earlier BBC report of the rumored crash.
